Here's a description of the line plot, following the guidelines provided:

The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPS and Loss Ratio for different configurations of a language model. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPS” and has a linear scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at intervals of 1e7. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The line representing “Vanilla” is purple with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 100 at 1e7 TFLOPS and decreasing to approximately 95 at 9e8 TFLOPS. The line representing “SepLLM (n=64)” is blue with square markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 100 at 1e7 TFLOPS and decreasing to approximately 96 at 9e8 TFLOPS. The line representing “SepLLM (n=128)” is orange with circle markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 100 at 1e7 TFLOPS and decreasing to approximately 96 at 9e8 TFLOPS. The line representing “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” is dark blue with cross markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 100 at 1e7 TFLOPS and decreasing to approximately 95 at 9e8 TFLOPS. Finally, the line representing “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” is green with plus markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 100 at 1e7 TFLOPS and decreasing to approximately 94 at 9e8 TFLOPS.
